credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]AirynS[/url] for reworking almost everything for me like a chad

iv noticed that the dungeons in stardew never seem to get any love so i redesigned the volcano dungeon along side the dragon tooth 
the dragon tooth comes in 6 colors you can change in config

the normal colors, pink,purple,reverse,bone and broken bone tooth with pink 

the dungeon file is optional 
unfortunalty i wasnt able to get the code to work so xnb is all i have 
ill put a back up so if yall change your mind yall dont have to redownload the game 


for the xnb go to C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Maps\Mines
and put it there.it will ask you if you want to replace it
